intro: Bay’s full-height unit blends practicality and efficiency, supporting organized and clutter-free environments. It's perfect for archiving, organizing, and reducing clutter.

features.title: Tall design, store more, save space
features.text: Vertical efficiency at its best: Bay offers generous capacity for files, supplies, or bulk items in a compact footprint.

features.title: Sturdy metal shutters, safe storage
features.text: Opaque metal shutters with cam locks provide reliable privacy and security for personal or sensitive office items.

features.title: Built for everyday use
features.text: Crafted from all-metal construction with a powder-coated finish, Bay stands up to daily office demands with ease.

features.title: Minimalist monolithic look
features.text: A flush, monolithic front creates a seamless look that integrates effortlessly into modular office environments.

features.title: Stability on every surface
features.text: Designed for consistency, the base adjusts to uneven surfaces, maintaining stability in any office environment.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Bay 900 X 1950 Metal Storage
